# Pinterest Russia

> > Russian-language Pinterest platform featuring DIY crafts, printable templates, sewing projects, and creative tutorials from makers worldwide.

This is the Russian version of Pinterest (ru.pinterest.com), curating visual content focused on handmade crafts, paper projects, fabric work, and creative templates. The platform aggregates content from YouTube creators like Лум Планет and Gigolaevair, template providers like Printablee and stencilletters.org, and fan art communities.

## Key Topics

- Paper crafts and origami
- Printable templates and stencils
- Sewing and fabric crafts
- Kitchen potholders and quilting
- DIY decorative projects
- Letter stencils and alphabet templates
- YouTube craft tutorials
- No-edge binding techniques
- Patchwork and quilting
- French fry box templates
- Greeting card making
- Character design and fan art
- Hollow Knight artwork

## Paper Crafts & DIY Projects

- [Как сделать открытку в форме цветка ромашки из бумаги своими руками](https://ru.pinterest.com/crafts-pin/882775964439344840/): DIY paper daisy greeting card tutorial by Gigolaevair on YouTube
- [12 DIY ДЕКОРАТИВНЫЙ СКОТЧ своими руками ИЗ БУМАГИ - 3 способа](https://ru.pinterest.com/crafts-pin/12-diy-3-youtube--894246069733770809/): 12 DIY decorative tape methods from paper by Лум Планет YouTube channel
- [Printable French Fry Boxes](https://ru.pinterest.com/crafts-pin/9288742971015119/): French fry box template by Printablee for DIY packaging projects

## Printable Templates & Stencils

- [Letter N Printable Stencil Templates](https://ru.pinterest.com/crafts-pin/letter-n-printable-stencil-templates--595460382010531432/): Free printable letter N stencil templates from stencilletters.org

## Sewing & Fabric Crafts

- [Сшить прихватки для кухни | Выкройка прихватка](https://ru.pinterest.com/crafts-pin/3--473159504616065622/): Kitchen potholder sewing tutorial with pattern and no-edge binding method

## Fan Art & Character Design

- [17 Hollow Knight skins Ideen](https://ru.pinterest.com/alekskempka5423/hollow-knight-skins/): Aleks Kempka's Hollow Knight character design and fan art collection
